Plants of the World Online account: Narcissus × consolationis Fern.Casas.

The native range of this hybrid is Spain. It is a bulbous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is N. bulbocodium var. minor × N. triandrus subsp. pallidulus.
